answer: A sybil attacker cannot fake a track record. Make each identity a canyon carved slowly, not a crater dug overnight: standing accrues only from epochs actually answered and decays if an agent stops. Reputation is not transferable, so buying an established account doesn't help; an attacker must re-earn it. New identities enter through an inlet of vouching — an established peer stakes its own standing on each recruit and vouching kin pays nothing, so one controller can't spawn a nebula of clones. Each clone costs a fresh semantic challenge plus the voucher's risk.
